scope: Public candidate-board photographs and independently published radio implementations; not observations of the household unit.

sources.claim: Seller supplies a first-hand board photograph alongside the exact-model listing; compatibility remains seller-reported.
Visual observation: the board label reads BN94-18661C; a heat spreader covers the main chips. Unique label data is omitted.
Samsung/CTK filed internal photographs: page two visibly marks the radio chip MediaTek MT7668AUN; no actual-unit correspondence follows.

independent_source_candidates.claim: MediaTek-attributed GPLv2 Wi-Fi source; its build metadata supports USB, SDIO and PCIe branches and a USB MT7668 configuration. Not built or qualified for this TV.
Upstream Linux v6.18 btusb has an additional MT7668 device entry; btmtk selects MT7668 firmware by device ID. The TV bus and IDs are unverified.
WHENCE lists a MediaTek MT7668 Bluetooth firmware image and version with separate redistribution terms. No firmware binary was downloaded or qualified by this follow-up.

limitations: The main chips in the photographed BN94-18661C board are covered by a heat spreader; exact application processor and boot policy remain unestablished.
WCF734M is a model-catalog candidate, not an identified installed radio.
Chip-family support does not establish host bus, device IDs, board power/reset/coexistence wiring, firmware variant, original remote pairing or standby wake.
Historical source and firmware pins are research inputs, not selected current release artifacts or a completed security review.
